race.description: Hennessy Real Estate Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIDE QUEST (8) made it two minor placings from the last three outings when edged out over 1250m at Gunnedah last start. Her two best performances have come when ridden on pace. Gets a chance to do that again from a favourable draw. Going well and ready to break through. FLAUNTER (11) has been in the money at all four runs, the pick of those performances coming last time out when a game second over 1280m at Muswellbrook. No luck again at the barrier draw but if she can cross easily this looks well within reach. BY THE WAY (7) returned from a five-month spell for new trainer Stirling Osland with a respectable fifth over 1175m at Grafton recently. This maiden isn't as deep so expect her to be highly competitive. Debutante BUCKO'S WISH (10) placed in a recent Grafton trial and looks to have ability. Impossible to make a case for the other runners.
